id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

editMode.description: Whether or not the user is editing the hierarchy

edits.description:
The edits made to the asset hierarchy, keyed by the asset id.
See {@link AssetOnboardingEditInfo} for more details on structure.

createdFacilityNames.description: The names of facilities to be created, keyed by the facility id.

renamedAssets.description: Assets and facilities that have been renamed, keyed by the asset id.

selectedAssetId.description: The id of the currently selected asset.

isFacility.description: Flag to indicate if the selected asset is a {@link Facility}.

redirectTo.description: Stores the url of the page user originally intended to navigate to when exiting asset onboarding edit mode.

formFieldValue.description: Stores the value of any editable, pre-populated form field on the page.

selectedNode.description: Stores the information of selected node on the AssetOnboardingApplicationState

getCellActionsForNodeFunction.description:
Stores the function to get the cell actions for a node in the asset hierarchy spreadsheet.

Takes two arguments, the node and whether or not this node is a facility.

currentSidePanelComponent.description:
Stores the identifier for the component to be shown in the side panel.

assetDefault
   - The default asset information component
assetAddCustom
   - The Add Custom Asset Interaction
assignAssetImportance
   - Assign Asset Importance Level interaction
assetDuplicate
   - The Add Duplicate Asset Interaction
facilityDuplicate
   - The Add Duplicate Facility Interaction
assetSaveAsHierarchy
   - The Save as Hierarchy Temaplate Interaction
facilityDefault
   - The default facility information component
facilityChangeHierarchyStatus
   - The Change Hierarchy Status component

title: Application state that stores all the UI logic for Asset Onboarding.
name: AssetOnboardingApplicationState
